version: Home Auth Signup Email Verification States G2-r36

proposed_behavior.purpose: Only local-signup email verification for the current account/email; no change-email, password alternative or additional Google verification.
proposed_behavior.shared_input: Retain selected six slots, auto advance/check at completion, paste/extraction/quiet-ignore and Backspace behavior. Six-digit completion alone is not verified success.
proposed_behavior.checking: Temporarily inactive code/resend during check, spinner/status; use-first/back/close remain exit paths without promising server rollback.
proposed_behavior.expired: Clear/inactivate code, expiry reason inline at code group, explicit request-new action; no invented expiry duration.
proposed_behavior.resend_pending: Temporary request-pending slots/action and progress status; no duplicate sends or delivery guarantee.
proposed_behavior.resend_wait: Current accepted-code input active; disabled resend countdown inside button only, no separate wait notice. 00:45 is fixture, not an approved wait duration.
proposed_behavior.resend_failed: Request-new attempt after no usable current code fails: slots remain inactive, form-level send failure and explicit send retry. Do not mark email/OTP invalid without that cause.
proposed_behavior.verify_failed: Indeterminate/service check failure retains code, form-level message and explicit check retry; not a confirmed wrong-code error and no automatic retry loop.
proposed_behavior.use_first: Visible/available in every displayed state, returns to active Home origin without the action itself marking email verified; actual operation outcome remains authoritative.
proposed_behavior.references_not_reapproved: Entry/success-r20 and inline invalid-r26 already accepted; not reopened or silently altered.
proposed_behavior.timing_provider_boundary: No new cooldown/lifetime/quota/provider/cancellation/session policy selected. Google accounts bypass local verification as already decided.

question: ใช้6สถานะยืนยันอีเมลตามภาพนี้ได้ไหมครับ? 1. ใช้ทั้ง6สถานะ 2. ปรับข้อความแจ้งสถานะ 3. ปรับปุ่มหรือทางใช้งานก่อน

verification.purpose_titles_and_use_first_count: Each full modal has one ยืนยันอีเมล title and one ใช้งานก่อน action.
verification.observation: Six adapted modals and grouped crops render completely, current email retained without edit, use-first visible, expiry inline and request/check service failures form-level. Static design, not runtime/keyboard/contrast certification.
